title: The Effect of Corporate Merger Transactions on the Information Content of Earnings Announcements*

rival_explanations: relative firm size (premerger sales / net income ratio) rather than relative earnings variability drives the weighting of combined-firm earnings

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (completed corporate mergers of publicly traded firms with Value Line and CRSP coverage)
context.country_region: United States (data from CRSP, Value Line, and The Wall Street Journal)
